issue.title: Problem with Interface LEDs on Dell S5248-ON

failure.body:
#### Description
I'm using a Dell S5248-ON switch. I've installed SONiC.master.207726-940e2cd9b on it.
The problem is that all interface lights are on (green) despite the fact I'm only using 4 Interfaces.

Only those LEDs should be on whose interfaces are being used.

#### Output of `show version`:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/92853499/224230573-296fbbcd-b616-4064-885f-9ef01457082a.png)

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
I've also faced another issue with the warm boot this happens on its own without giving any prompt.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/92853499/224291208-ba71d2ae-f0cc-40cd-9ed9-6879d6b50346.png)
